dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - July 18, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Pirates' Bats Explode in Doubleheader Sweep**

In a thrilling doubleheader, the Pittsburgh Pirates took down the Cleveland Guardians 7-1 and 3-5. Jacob Gonzalez led the charge for the Pirates, hitting two home runs and driving in two runs in the first game. Jared Jones was dominant on the mound, striking out nine batters over five innings. In the second game, Travis Bazzana hit a home run and drove in two runs for the Guardians, but the Pirates' bullpen held on for the win.

**Cubs Take Down Twins Behind Kody Clemens' Power**

The Chicago Cubs defeated the Minnesota Twins 6-2 behind a strong outing from Mike Paredes and a pair of home runs from Kody Clemens. Clemens finished the game 2-for-4 with two home runs and two RBIs, leading the Cubs to their third win in a row.

**Phillies Rout Mets in One-Sided Affair**

The Philadelphia Phillies dominated the New York Mets 6-1, with Jesús Luzardo throwing five strong innings and striking out seven batters. Trea Turner led the Phillies' offense with three hits, including a home run.

**Blue Jays Edge White Sox in Low-Scoring Affair**

The Toronto Blue Jays took down the Chicago White Sox 1-0 behind a strong outing from Shane Bieber, who threw six shutout innings and struck out six batters. George Springer drove in the winning run with a single in the top of the ninth.

**Rangers Come From Behind to Beat Braves**

The Texas Rangers came from behind to defeat the Atlanta Braves 7-6, with MacKenzie Gore earning the win after throwing 1.1 scoreless innings of relief. Evan Carter hit a home run and drove in two runs for the Rangers, who overcame a 6-3 deficit to take the lead.

**Giants Fall to Mariners in Close Game**

The San Francisco Giants fell to the Seattle Mariners 4-3 in a close game, with Bryan Woo throwing six strong innings and striking out seven batters. Cole Young hit a home run and drove in three runs for the Giants, but the Mariners' bullpen held on for the win.

**Athletics Rout Nationals in Blowout**

The Oakland Athletics dominated the Washington Nationals 15-1, with J.T. Ginn throwing six shutout innings and striking out seven batters. Jacob Wilson hit a home run and drove in two runs for the Athletics, who scored 15 runs on 15 hits.

**Tigers Shut Out Angels**

The Detroit Tigers shut out the Los Angeles Angels 7-0 behind a strong outing from Tarik Skubal, who threw seven shutout innings and struck out nine batters. Spencer Torkelson hit two home runs and drove in four runs for the Tigers, who scored seven runs on 10 hits.

**Dodgers Take Down Yankees**

The Los Angeles Dodgers defeated the New York Yankees 8-2 behind a strong outing from Yoshinobu Yamamoto, who threw nine shutout innings and struck out seven batters. Trent Grisham hit a home run and drove in one run for the Dodgers, who took a 2-0 lead in the series.
